purpose: Informational context for bank balance-sheet expansion and U.S. Treasury maturity composition. It cannot override Money Core, Funding, Fiscal, Market Confirmation or the frozen 10-point conviction rubric.

bank_balance_sheet_impulse.label: Bank balance-sheet impulse
bank_balance_sheet_impulse.interpretation: Impulse = latest 13-week asset growth minus the preceding 13-week asset growth. Positive means bank balance-sheet expansion is accelerating; negative means it is decelerating. No GMLI score impact.

treasury_duration_mix.label: Treasury duration mix proxy
treasury_duration_mix.source: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data — Monthly Statement of the Public Debt, Table 1
treasury_duration_mix.basis: Debt held by the public; standard marketable classes only
treasury_duration_mix.interpretation: Short/floating proxy = Bills + FRNs; fixed-duration proxy = Notes + Bonds + TIPS. This is a face-value composition proxy, not DV01, weighted-average maturity or an issuance-flow model. No GMLI score impact.
treasury_duration_mix.coverage_note: Federal Financing Bank securities are excluded from this proxy.

guardrail: Display-only research diagnostic. Any future scoring use requires a separately frozen, versioned candidate and promotion gate.
